_doc: R1 licence rule (2026-10-03, approved 2026-10-04; item 72 W4). Reject ONLY: ND, no-educational-use, fee-only. Plain NC is accepted. Missing/unknown licence is held (defer). Detection is by the DECLARED licence id/url and the known markers below only; text inside a page is not scanned. Matching is case-insensitive on tokens split at non-alphanumerics; multi-word markers match as contiguous token runs.

nd_news._doc: H19 (OD-1106-NEWS): ships OFF; flipped only by the release gate (design T9) after NC-BASIS-1 is on record and T8 passes. When on, an ND CONTENT licence of a listed family on a host whose derived access verdict (vera/news_access.py) is full_text is answer-only (decision defer, never stored). Phase B storage is exception X-1.
